description: Modify the edit prediction system to distinguish between local and remote edits during collaboration sessions. When multiple users are editing the same document, ensure that edit predictions only trigger for the local user's edits, not for changes made by other collaborators.
functional_requirements: Add a mechanism to identify whether an edit originates from the local user or a remote collaborator
Modify the edit prediction system to only process local edits and ignore remote edits
Ensure the fix works across all collaboration scenarios without affecting single-user editing behavior
